title: Akhilesh Yadav defends Mohan; BJP accused of CM purge
summary: Congress leader Akhilesh Yadav claims the BJP is conspiring to remove three Chief Ministers, including defending MP and former CM Mohan Yadav against land allegations. While some reports suggest a conspiracy within the party or criticism from opposition blocs regarding land deals, other outlets note that Congress officials have demanded Mohan's resignation.
summary_points: Akhilesh Yadav alleges the BJP is conspiring to oust three Chief Ministers.
title_hi: अखिलेश यादव मोहन की रक्षा करते हैं; भाजपा में सीएम हटाने का आरोप
